companions.name: caveman
companions.title: Caveman
companions.access: Four skills only: no hooks, no MCP server, no file or network access of its own. Off until you type /caveman; paused in plan mode.
companions.license: MIT (the skills the entry loads; the repository's engine-linked directories are not fetched).
companions.fallback: Caveman is not installed: answers stay in normal prose. Run /cross-stack-standard:adopt to install it.

companions.name: impeccable
companions.title: Impeccable
companions.purpose: Design review of UI changes: audit, critique and polish against the project's tokens.
companions.access: Its skill and four agents, which read and edit files in the project like any skill; its hooks are not installed.
companions.network: Downloads its engine binary from GitHub on the first command; a daily version check and optional choice reporting (see the FAQ for switches).
companions.fallback: Impeccable is not available: the UI change was not design-reviewed. Review it against the project's tokens by hand, or install impeccable with /cross-stack-standard:adopt.

companions.name: figma
companions.title: Figma MCP
companions.purpose: Read designs, components and variables from Figma files.
companions.access: A remote MCP server that reads what your Figma account can see once you sign in; tools that write to Figma files ask first.
companions.network: mcp.figma.com, only after you sign in with /mcp.
companions.license: Upstream plugin licence (figma/mcp-server-guide); the Figma service is under Figma's terms.
companions.fallback: Figma MCP is not connected: sign in with /mcp, or paste the design values (colors, spacing, sizes) into the chat.

companions.name: chrome-devtools-mcp
companions.title: Chrome DevTools MCP
companions.purpose: Check the running app in a real browser: console, network, performance, accessibility.
companions.access: Drives an isolated Chrome profile that can see cookies and headers of the pages it opens; pages outside local and development hosts, page scripts and file uploads ask first.
companions.network: npm registry once for the pinned package, then only the pages it opens; usage statistics, CrUX lookups and update checks are off.
companions.fallback: Chrome DevTools MCP is not available: the UI was not checked in a browser. Open the changed screens yourself, or install it with /cross-stack-standard:adopt.
